== Biography ==
Arthur was born about 1815. He was the son of [[Glasgow-822|John Glasgow]] and [[Arthur-2480|Mary Arthur]].

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-822]] is assessed at 99% (proved). The visually checked John Glasgow/Mary Arthur family register lists Arthur born 1 July 1815 among their nine children, exactly matching this Arthur. John’s held letter of 20 March 1847 calls Arthur his son and describes his care for both parents; the 1850 Londonderry, Ohio household places the same parents with Arthur. These independent lifetime details bridge the recorded child to the adult family.

Confident 99% for this named father and exact-date child/adult identity. The earlier 66% review considered only the inherited FamilySearch account and missed the already held register, letter and household evidence; its basis remains in the assessment history. The register image was visually re-inspected, not newly discovered.

Next useful test: Use the dated letter and register together if an adult namesake is proposed; investigate John’s earlier ancestry separately.

Source basis already held: [https://hiltner.com/mckeown/histories/8479.jpeg Glasgow family Bible, family register of John Glasgow and Mary Arthur, original register image (https://hiltner.com/mckeown/histories/8479.jpeg); media description (https://hiltner.com/mckeown/showmedia.php?mediaID=532&medialinkID=726), McKeown and Shields Families; the collection is indexed at hiltner.com/mckeown (https://hiltner.com/mckeown/index.php), accessed 29 August 2026.]; [https://www.hiltner.com/mckeown/documents/John%20Glasgow%20letter%20to%20Jane%20Glasgow%20Gray%203-20-1847.pdf John Glasgow to Jane Glasgow Gray, 20 March 1847 (https://www.hiltner.com/mckeown/documents/John%20Glasgow%20letter%20to%20Jane%20Glasgow%20Gray%203-20-1847.pdf), scan and transcript (accessed 20 July 2026).]; [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MX3M-HP3 They were living in Arthur's household in Londonderry Township in 1850. “United States Census, 1850,” database with images, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MX3M-HP3 : 12 April 2016), John Glasgow in household of Arthur Glasgow, Londonderry, Guernsey, Ohio, United States; citing family 1538, NARA microfilm publication M432.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-822]] is assessed at 66% (probable). Arthur’s family account specifically names John Glasgow and Mary Arthur, a distinctive full parental pairing compatible with Arthur’s c 1815 birth and the selected John’s 1767 generation. Its support is an inherited FamilySearch family account rather than a parent-naming contemporary record.

Probable 66%; the full couple is a useful identification, with a relatively late paternal age and no independent parent clause held.

Next useful test: Locate Arthur’s original baptism or death record naming his parents.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-1608 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-1608]. No new original inspected; no new father attached.
